topic: Remediation of all 8 items from the external adversarial security review before public open-source release.
summary: Replaced flawed `resolved.startswith(self.workspace_root)` check with `os.path.commonpath([self.workspace_root, resolved]) == self.workspace_root`.; Updated documentation clarifying the firewall is an advisory guard against accidental commands, not an impregnable security boundary.; Added traversal regression tests in `desktop/tests/test_firewall.py`.

topic: Product Rebranding and Clean Repository Initialization for AudioMind
summary: Updated desktop tray title, icon name, and menu header to `AudioMind`.; Updated floating waveform HUD title, default states, and pill capsule geometry (`width=240`) for `AudioMind • Listening`, `Speaking`, `Paused`, `Thinking`.; Created `scripts/Launch_AudioMind.bat` and updated `AntiVoiceAssistant.cs` assembly metadata.

`desktop/app.py`: `submit_to_antigravity_chat` now returns bool and sends no keystrokes unless the Antigravity window was found and is the foreground window, checked after focusing and again right before Ctrl+A/Ctrl+V/Enter. Added `is_foreground_window()`.; Remote dispatch path: a failed paste clears the pending dispatch and ACKs `FAILED` ("Nothing was typed").; Voice path: a failed paste is announced with a spoken message.

topic: Audit and ownership of commits `d7642bb`, `4bd3976`, `b2d708f`, `46ddc93`; live desktop telemetry on Windows hardware; UIPI elevation boundary discovery; clipboard protection and candidate gating.
summary: Commits introduced `is_foreground_window` gating and `Ctrl+L` (`antigravity.toggleChatFocus`) invocation for Antigravity IDE.; Refined `is_foreground_window` to support `wintypes.HWND` / int types safely and check root window ancestor (`GA_ROOT = 2`) so nested panel focus within the IDE window is correctly recognized without leaking keystrokes outside the application.; Moved `set_clipboard_text(prompt_text)` in `submit_to_antigravity_chat` to execute *only after* window focus is confirmed. This guarantees that if focus fails, the user's existing system clipboard is never overwritten.

topic: Playback Intent Collision Remediation, Semaphore Concurrency & Aligned Chapter Synthesis, and Fail-Closed Tri-State Elevation Check
summary: Replaced substring matching (`any(w in clean_cmd for w in ...)`) with pure function `match_playback_intent(text: str, speech_active: bool) -> Optional[str]`.; Playback commands only evaluate while speech is active (`is_speech_active()`).; Whole normalized utterance matching against allow-list sets for `PAUSE`, `RESUME`, `REWIND_5`, `NEXT_CHAPTER`, `REPEAT_CHAPTER`, and `STOP`.

topic: Remediation of adversarial edge cases (hostname bypass, textarea concatenation, uncorrelated Done-ACKs) and git history leak assessment.
summary: Replaced prefix matching (`url.startswith("http://localhost")`) with `urllib.parse.urlparse(url).hostname`.; Only allows `https://` (with valid hostname) or `http://` where `parsed.hostname in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost")`.; Defeats subdomain attacks such as `http://localhost.attacker.com` and `http://127.0.0.1.attacker.com`.

topic: Audit, Empirical Verification, and Calibration of the 7 Cognitive Pillars for Anti Voice Assistant
summary: Audited all 7 SDCS pillars against physical code and architecture realities in the repository.; Eliminated residual hardcoded `FFMPEG_PATH` in `desktop/audio/tts.py` and `desktop/model/train_hey_anti.py`; replaced with dynamic lookup (`shutil.which`, `os.environ`, and fallback) conforming to REJ-002.; Hardened Cloud Relay tenant authentication in `relay/agent_dispatch_router.py` to fail closed (HTTP 401) on missing or invalid auth headers when `RELAY_AUTH_SECRET` is set, conforming to Constitutional Axiom 2. Added test coverage in `relay/test_relay.py`.

topic: Speech Playback Forward And Chapter Controls
summary: Chapter Markers & Titles:** Added `chapter_markers: list[int]` and `chapter_titles: list[str]` tracking sample offsets and human-readable chapter names.; Fast Forward (5s):** Enhanced `fast_forward(seconds=5.0)` to skip forward by 5 seconds (240,000 samples at 48kHz) and fire `"forwarded"` state notification.; Skip to Next Chapter:** Implemented `skip_to_next_chapter() -> Optional[int]` to advance to the next chapter marker, or seek to the end if on the final chapter.

topic: Correction of live telemetry record for cases 3a/3b; Win32 TokenElevation mismatch detection; fail-closed rejection with speech warning and remote FAILED ACK; removal of administrator execution recommendation; README troubleshooting addition.
summary: Corrected `sessions/2026-10-11_ide_focus_review_and_telemetry.md` and `state.md`.; Recorded that synthetic keystrokes in cases 3a (editor tab) and 3b (integrated terminal) were dropped by Windows UIPI because `Antigravity IDE.exe` was running elevated with `~ RUNASADMIN`. Live execution was not observed.; Implemented `is_process_elevated(pid)`, `is_current_process_elevated()`, and `check_elevation_mismatch(target_pid)`.

topic: Universal Cross-App Highlighted Text Reader and Chapter Skip Termination Fix
summary: Retained structured markdown (`\n\n` paragraph breaks, heading tokens) in `clean_markdown_for_speech` and `TranscriptWatcher.on_new_response` so chapter segmentation is preserved before text cleaning.; Refined `extract_chapters_from_text` to strip markdown links (`[Title](url)`), symbols, and leading emojis from extracted chapter titles.; Added sentence-cluster chapter partitioning fallback for long continuous text blocks (> 75 words) lacking explicit markdown headers.

Added `self.on_click = None` callback attribute.; Added `cursor="hand2"` to `self.canvas` so mouse hover visually signals clickability.; Bound `<Button-1>` on both `self.canvas` and `self.root` to `_on_canvas_click`.

topic: Remediation of "AudioMind • Preparing..." UI freeze, Edge-TTS 403 failover, and offline SAPI speech integration.
summary: Implemented `synth_sapi_pcm()` utilizing `SAPI.SpVoice`, `SpMemoryStream`, and `SpAudioFormat` type 39 (`SAFT48kHz16BitStereo`).; Automatically selects natural voice (e.g. `Microsoft Zira Desktop`) and decodes raw int16 PCM into 48kHz stereo float32 arrays via `numpy` in < 150ms.; Preserves multi-chapter structure and chapter boundaries during offline synthesis.
